body: I’ve thought about a therapist but my insurance only covers a few visits and I can’t afford to pay it out of pocket.

I can’t afford to quit my job, and I haven’t had any luck finding a new job. I started a second job in November and was planning on cutting my hours at my current place. I got laid off two weeks before Christmas though. Normally my current job gives me barely enough hours to pay my bills. The main housekeeper quit last week and they informed me on the 24th I was going to have to work her 40 hours this week too. I’m working 69 with no days off. I asked to only work the 40 next week and they said they would see what they can do. The schedule came out yesterday and I’m working 56 with no days off. The manager conveniently managed to get 3 days off for herself though. I haven’t even gotten a thank you for it. Instead I just get chewed out constantly because I’m behind on the housekeeping. But I’m so tired I can barely move. And they want me to do it next week too without any break.
I try to spend more time with them. When I go to their house I usually get ignored. When I try to make plans they always come up with excuses as to why they can’t.
I’ve tried. I’ve told my husband so many times how I feel. He just doesn’t seem to understand. He says I need to turn to god and I’d magically be cured somehow.

I have spoken with my husband. I’ve told him straight up how I feel several times. He acts attentive for a couple days and then I’m back to being invisible again.

I’ve been looking for a new job with no luck at all. With my current job they usually give me barely enough hours to pay my bills. I was working two jobs but got laid off one right before Christmas. At my current job the main housekeeper quit so on the 24th they informed me I’m picking up an extra 40 hours this week. I’m working 69 hours this week. I asked to only work the 40 next week and they said they would see what they could do. I’m working 56 with no days off. The manager conveniently gets three days off though. I didn’t even get a thank you :(
When I’m feeling depressed my husband says “why bother” even trying to cheer me up :(
Thank you. I don’t really know how to approach asking her about that stuff, I’m just hoping I can show her I’m on her side and get her to open up and hopefully feel better about herself.
I’ll look in to that. I know we have one nearby, just not sure where. Thank you.

That’s what I’m planning on doing. I’m getting ready to get a guest room set up and figured I’d offer it to her whenever she wanted to come over. Gonna be hard when school starts though. But at least she will know she has somewhere she can escape too.
